children: Germany tire recycling tech provider's H1 revenue grew 37.6% yr/yr, but missed internal targets
Company lowered 2026 revenue and EBIT forecasts due to production delays at Dillingen plant
EUR 24 mln grant committed for Swedish recycling project with GreenTech Recycling Tires AB
Pyrum lowers 2026 revenue forecast to EUR 4.2 mln-5.3 mln from EUR 6.5 mln-9.5 mln
Company cuts 2026 total output outlook to EUR 11.0 mln-14.0 mln from EUR 12.0 mln-18.0 mln
Pyrum expects 2026 EBIT of EUR -10.0 mln to EUR -12.5 mln, down from EUR -8.0 mln to EUR -10.5 mln
DELAYED PLANT RAMP-UP - Co said revenue missed its expectations due to delayed ramp-up of Dillingen grinding and pelletizing plant
TECHNICAL BOTTLENECKS - Co attributed production shortfall to bottlenecks in conveyance system at Dillingen plant
EXTENDED PRODUCTION HOURS - Co said night shifts and extended hours approved to partly offset production shortfall, but higher costs expected
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Pyrum Innovations AG is €27.60, about 10.7% below its September 22 closing price of €30.90
